verdict.language_detail: MATLAB (Image Acquisition Toolbox, Computer Vision Toolbox)
verdict.provenance_detail: Student/hobbyist object detection script using webcam and MATLAB Image Acquisition Toolbox
verdict.purpose: Real-time red object detector using a webcam: captures video frames, subtracts the red channel from grayscale to isolate red regions, applies morphological filtering, labels blobs, draws bounding boxes and centroids, records centroid positions, and fits a B-spline trajectory through detected positions.
